mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to increase the pH in acid soils where crops are intolerant of high aluminium (Al) saturation, which often (but not always) accompanies low soil pH."
Liming materials are used to increase the pH in acid soils where crops are intolerant of high aluminium (Al) saturation, which often (but not always) accompanies low soil pH.

Effective Neutralising Value (ENV) The ENV is the fraction of the material's CCE that will react with soil acidity in the first year of application.

The Caesalpiniodeae is considered to be the oldest and ancestral subfamily from which the other sub-families diverged.

A high CEC is regarded as favourable as it contributes to the capacity of soils to retain plant nutrient cations.

The 'nitrogen effect' component is a result of the N provision from BN, which is highest in situations of low N fertilization to subsequent crop cycles.

soil structure stability refers to the resistance of soil to structural rearrangement of pores and particles when exposed to different stresses (e.g. cultivation, trampling/ compaction, and irrigation).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a material that contains at least one of the plant nutrients in chemical form that, when applied to the soil, is soluble in the soil solution phase and 'available' for plant roots."
Fertilizer is a material that contains at least one of the plant nutrients in chemical form that, when applied to the soil, is soluble in the soil solution phase and 'available' for plant roots.

Green manure can be defined as a practice of ploughing or turning into the soil undecomposed green plant tissues for improving physical structure and soil fertility.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the movement of plant nutrients in flowing soil solution towards a root that is actively drawing water from the soil."
Mass flow is the movement of plant nutrients in flowing soil solution towards a root that is actively drawing water from the soil.

Clay minerals are the most important sources of soil K excluding that from fertilizers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the quantity (weight) of fertilizer that should be applied per unit area of farm land for a given crop."
Fertilizer rate is the quantity (weight) of fertilizer that should be applied per unit area of farm land for a given crop.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the loss of soluble phosphorus from sub-surface soil as water percolates vertically down the soil profile."
Leaching is the loss of soluble phosphorus from sub-surface soil as water percolates vertically down the soil profile.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an agroforestry system in which crops are grown between rows of planted woody shrubs or trees."
Alley cropping is an agroforestry system in which crops are grown between rows of planted woody shrubs or trees.

fertile soil
